title: T1200 — Hardware Additions
subtitle: A visitor plants a matchbox-sized network implant.
aria: Animated simulation of a hardware addition attack: an attacker plants a network implant on an office wall port, the implant gets a DHCP lease, beacons out, scans the internal network, opens a reverse tunnel, and the SOC detects the unknown MAC and port-security violation.
